scene_summary: A large scratched silver optical slab curves across a pale background, exposing a transparent layered bevel above a rough black-and-ochre lower field. An orange vertical edge anchors the left side. Visible interaction targets include a stepped missing section, a dark lower-field gap, localized diffraction light, separate edge chips, and a pitted cluster. No readable labels, distinct Signal Panel, or Reference Plaque are visible. Planned labels below identify plausible visual anchors, not independently verified source identities.
usable_surfaces: Stepped cutout exposing silver skin and transparent bevel
Dark elongated lower-field interruption with an abraded upper lip
Small dark chip along the lower-right optical edge
Lifted silver fragment with exposed layered underside
Pinhole cluster in the scratched silver surface

detected_objects.label: Broad diffraction notch
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The upper-left curved edge contains a visibly missing stepped section. Its dark horizontal upper lip, jagged inner wall, exposed clear material, and returning silver edge form one contiguous cutout. This is the clearest broad missing section, although it is smaller than the hero-scale territory described in the plan.

detected_objects.label: Scratch-veiled pressure gap
detected_objects.visual_evidence: An elongated near-black interruption crosses the lower textured field beneath and to the left of the slab. Ochre abrasion follows its uneven upper lip. It provides the closest visible pressure-gap anchor; the planned scratch veil and exact junction with the displaced shadow are not distinctly resolved.

detected_objects.label: Color Node
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A concentrated diagonal cyan-blue diffraction streak crosses the right side of the silver surface. The polygon follows the luminous streak rather than the surrounding broad metallic field.

detected_objects.label: Field Marker
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A separate irregular black cavity sits in the foreground pressure band, bounded by a thin ochre rim and granular dark ridges. It is distinctly below the longer pressure gap and does not reuse that feature.

detected_objects.label: Edge Detail
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small squared but irregular bite interrupts the lower-right silver edge. A dark upright inner face and clear lower bevel distinguish the chip from the adjacent blue diffraction streak.

detected_objects.label: Layered Fragment
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Near the center of the descending rim, a silver tongue ends above an exposed dark ledge and translucent chipped material. The tight territory follows this layered termination, not the larger scratched slab or its entire diagonal fracture.

detected_objects.label: Distributed Marker
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A localized diagonal cluster of pits and chipped silver surrounds a prominent dark oval hole on the upper-right slab. Smaller holes continue downward and rightward. The contour encloses this damaged cluster as a single territory rather than assigning each pit a separate source.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Estimated mapped coverage is small and confined to visible marks. The composition has three dominant material forms: the curved optical slab, orange upright, and dark lower band. Their arrangement is restrained, but dense scratches, granular ridges, repeated cavities, and photorealistic material detail make the plate texturally busy rather than clearly minimal and expressionist. It is not overloaded with separate objects or interface chrome.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
